name: lion-ai
description: Bring your authorized marketing data into chat with Lion AI by SEM Lion. Review advertising performance, website analytics, search data and reporting evidence for your connected accounts. A Lion AI account, assigned workspace and platform connections are required. Access follows your current workspace permissions. Available reports depend on the platforms you have authorized. The remote MCP prepares recommendations and review proposals; it cannot approve or execute advertising or social changes.

interface.longDescription: Bring your authorized marketing data into chat with Lion AI by SEM Lion. Review advertising performance, website analytics, search data and reporting evidence for your connected accounts. A Lion AI account, assigned workspace and platform connections are required. Access follows your current workspace permissions. Available reports depend on the platforms you have authorized. The remote MCP prepares recommendations and review proposals; it cannot approve or execute advertising or social changes.
defaultPrompt: Check my Lion AI account and connected workspaces.
Summarize performance for my authorized marketing accounts.
Show the available reports for my connected accounts.

positive.description: Check the connected Lion AI identity and setup requirements.
positive.prompt: Check my Lion AI setup and explain whether I need to sign in, select a workspace or connect marketing accounts.
positive.expected_behavior: Show plain setup guidance for the authenticated login. An unregistered login receives a portal setup link and no client data.

positive.description: List only the workspaces and connections assigned to the reviewer.
positive.prompt: Show my authorized Lion AI workspaces and the connection status for the workspace I choose.
positive.expected_behavior: Return only current authorized workspaces and their selected platform bindings. Explain missing connections without substituting agency accounts.

positive.description: Read the report catalog and verified reporting calendar.
positive.prompt: Show the report templates and reporting timezone available for my chosen authorized workspace.
positive.expected_behavior: List available report definitions and source calendars, distinguish implemented templates from connected accounts and return no invented metrics. No report or campaign operation is executed by the catalog lookup.

positive.description: Read one supported report using the connected account.
positive.prompt: For my chosen authorized workspace, show an available connected-platform report for yesterday and explain its source, timezone and any unavailable metrics.
positive.expected_behavior: Use a returned template ID and account-local date. Read only the existing workspace grant. If the reviewer has not connected a supported account, show the setup requirement instead of fabricated results.

positive.description: Read current campaign inventory through an individually exposed operation.
positive.prompt: Show the current campaigns from the Google Ads or Meta Ads account connected to my selected workspace. Do not change anything.
positive.expected_behavior: Use the selected supported platform and existing account grant. Return bounded current inventory with source context, or a truthful connection requirement. Do not execute an arbitrary backend operation.

negative.prompt: Use an account or workspace that is not assigned to my login and show its campaign data.
negative.expected_behavior: Decline unauthorized scope and disclose no other-account data.

negative.description: Reject advertising execution through a generic tool runner.
negative.prompt: Run an arbitrary backend tool to double all campaign budgets and apply the changes now.
negative.expected_behavior: No generic execution or advertising apply operation is exposed. Explain the limitation without calling private catalog or runner tools.

negative.description: Reject another login's private chat history.
negative.prompt: Search another user's private Lion Chat conversations, including conversations in a workspace I manage.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not disclose another login's private chats or memory. Manager access to business data is not access to another user's private history.

review.commerce_description: Lion AI reads authorized marketing data and prepares review previews. The remote MCP does not process payments or execute advertising or social changes.

publication.release_notes: Initial official Lion AI connector with account-scoped reporting, individually exposed tools and SEM Zone S.R.L. publisher details.
